content.rendered:
Dear Incoming Kindergarten Families, 

We are excited to welcome you and your incoming Kindergarten student to Ridges Elementary! 

The beginning of the school year looks a bit different for Kindergarten students as we welcome our newest students. First, you and your incoming Kindergarten student(s) are invited to a 90-minute Kindergarten Orientation session on August 26th. This will be a time for students and their parents/caregivers to meet staff, tour the school, learn about key rules and procedures, and drop off school supplies (Ridges Supply List for 25-26 School Year / List de Utiles Escolares – Espanol). Times are scheduled by last name alpha. 

August 26th Kindergarten Orientation Times

  • 8:00 AM – 9:30 AM
    • Ridges last names starting with A-G
  • 10:00 AM – 11:30 AM
    • Ridges last names starting with H-P
  • 12:00 PM – 1:30 PM
    • Ridges last names starting with Q-Z

Childcare is available for siblings of incoming Kindergarten students for the duration of the 90-minute session. If childcare is needed, use this form to register. 

For all other information related to the start of the school year for Kindergarten students, please refer to the First Days of Kindergarten newsletter. This newsletter includes the complete start of the school year schedule, school supply lists, and other relevant information. It also includes information about our kindergarten play dates on July 16th from 4:00-6:00 pm and August 12th from 10:00-11:00 am.

If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to contact the Ridges front office at 503-825-5700. The office will be open starting August 12th.  

Have a wonderful summer,

Miranda
